entries.statement: Phase 3 verdict is STOP BEFORE PHASE 4, computed from a pre-registration frozen before any governed symbolic run.

Phase 3 G1B selected-form functional and symbolic recovery was 0% at low, moderate and adverse noise regimes; the search found the law in 100% of low and moderate worlds while the system reported it in 0% and 10%.

Phase 3 selector mechanism: a complexity-6 approximation within 0.004 held-out R2 of the complexity-13 planted form was selected in 30 of 30 seeds at every noise level, under an elbow tolerance of 0.01 absolute R2.
Phase 3 and Type 2 each observed 0 accepted worlds among 100 pure nulls, with a Clopper-Pearson exact 95% interval of [0.0000, 0.0362].
entries.reporting_rule: The interval is the claim. p = 0 language is not used for a finite simulation count.

entries.statement: Phase 3 null threshold at complexity 20 was +0.4889 with bootstrap interval [+0.2603, +0.6859], from 40 calibration worlds.

Type 2 verdict is DO NOT AUTHORIZE PHASE 4; exactly one of thirteen decision conditions failed, independent-engine corroboration at 15% support and 25% mass-exponent agreement against a 50% requirement on each.

Type 2 G1B moderate positive controls: Type 2 success 17/20 (85%), support 20/20, exponent recovery 18/20, shape recovery 20/20, median selection frequency 30/30, median test R2 0.9535, median ceiling fraction 1.1158, family recovery 16/20 measured.
entries.qualification: Obtained under a historical estimator later established as transductive (FM-06). Not eligible as a prospective endpoint.
entries.wording_rule: 17/20 is the composite Type 2 success gate (support, exponent, shape). 16/20 is dense-lattice family recovery, measured not gated. Neither is the prospective G2 definition, which requires support MATCH and family MATCH. Never quote 17/20 as the historical family-recovery rate, and never present either as comparable to prospective G2 on 144.

entries.statement: Type 2 mass exponent on the 20 G1B moderate worlds had median 0.500 and range [0.448, 0.540] against a planted 0.5, with 20 of 20 within +/-0.15.

Type 2 symbolic equivalence to the planted law was 0 in every positive-control block; the reported family contained a median of 8.5 distinct functional-equivalence classes on G1B moderate; algebraic identification was claimed in 0 of 20 worlds and 0 of 10 G1C worlds.
Type 2 refusal blocks: G2 0/8 accepted, G3 0/8 non-mass structural claims, G4M 0/30, GC 0/9, G5 0/8, GRT 0/4; H-MAIN rejected 8/8 in G2 only.
Type 2 within-compound energy permutation produced p95 of +0.7228 at complexity 20 against +0.0835 to +0.1509 for the other three constructions, and set the pooled gate almost single-handedly.

Type 2 enlarged calibration to 100 worlds, narrowing the mean bootstrap interval width across complexities to 0.109 against Phase 3's 0.426 at complexity 20 alone; the Type 2 complexity-20 threshold was +0.6831 with interval [+0.6392, +0.6993].
Type 2 F8 structural-beyond-mass labelling certified only 1 of 19 accepted G1B moderate worlds, against 3 of 6 on a fully synthetic covariate frame.
Type 2 G1B success by noise regime: 100% at residual SD 0.010, 85% at 0.0295, 30% at 0.060.
entries.note: 0.0295 is the Phase 1 conservative inter-mixture variability estimate, an upper bound on technical repeatability, not an instrument noise floor

entries.statement: Engine competence audit: frozen gplearn failed C0 (mean elementary scaling 57.5% against 80%), C1 (non-mass carrier scaling 25% against 50%) and C2 (mean E5/E6 support 15% and exponent 45% against 50%); on fresh E6 it achieved 30% block support and 45% mass exponent where matched PySR achieved 100% on both legs.
entries.binding_qualification: Removes the inference that non-agreement demonstrated PySR artifacts. Does NOT turn the failed Type 2 corroboration gate into a pass. DO NOT AUTHORIZE PHASE 4 remains binding.

entries.statement: Transductive-estimator perturbation audit: changing one trajectory changed other compounds' g_hat by up to 0.0987, weights by up to 1.2818, Phi knots by 0.0908, and residual SD from 0.00963 to 0.01050, in a synthetic 40-compound check.

Phase 2 mass-coupling sensitivity: a 50 Da absolute low-mass cutoff with proportional chemistry produced Spearman rho of -0.4791 at NCE 90, against an observed real-data rho of -0.6759, with no chemistry in the construction.
entries.binding_qualification: Does not identify an artifactual fraction of the real association. No such fraction is claimed.

entries.statement: Real-data confirmation set is 110 compounds across 82 scaffold groups, sealed at SHA-256 d6b6b13585978768ade9155d1efb927f9e6067500eda2288653d6257c5461b07, recomputed unchanged before and after each study.
Highest defensible real-data claims-ladder rung is L3, unchanged by every synthetic study.
Phase 3 executed 240 worlds at 30 PySR seeds (7,200 runs) with a 680-run gplearn subset; Type 2 executed 323 PySR worlds at 30 seeds (9,690 runs) with an 880-run gplearn arm.
Historical worlds used 0.97% energy dropout and retained at least five energies, with no per-trajectory coverage guard, coverage report, or missingness stress study.
The historical estimator returned a grid endpoint when the optimum lay outside [-1.6, 1.6] and did not record boundary hits.
Phase 3 stop conditions: G1 recovery below 80% at the moderate noise regime FIRED; all seven other conditions did not fire, including K6.

entries.statement: Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bounds for the historical zero-count refusal blocks, computed for this manuscript rather than quoted from a repository artifact.
entries.source_artifact: computed by this work from the counts recorded in TYPE2_VALIDATION_DECISION.md
entries.method: two-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bound for x = 0: 1 - (alpha/2)**(1/n) with alpha = 0.05, i.e. 1 - 0.025**(1/n)
entries.method_validation: At n = 100 this yields 0.0362, reproducing exactly the interval [0.0000, 0.0362] recorded independently in PHASE3_DECISION.md and TYPE2_VALIDATION_DECISION.md. The method is therefore the one the repository used.

unsupported_number_policy: No SCIENTIFIC quantity appears in the manuscript package without a corresponding entry above: every count, denominator, threshold, seed constant, rate and interval. Any such statement lacking a verified source is written as [METHOD DETAIL REQUIRES VERIFIED SOURCE] rather than estimated. Two classes of number are deliberately NOT given individual entries, because they are self-verifying against the repository rather than against this ledger: (1) commit SHAs and tags, each of which is checked by `git rev-parse <ref>` and `git log -1 --format=%s <ref>` and is listed in MURU_REPRODUCIBILITY_INVENTORY.md sections 2 and 3; (2) inventory bookkeeping counts such as lockfile pin counts and test-module counts, which are checked by running the command named beside them. Entries E035 to E038 cover the bookkeeping counts a reviewer flagged as load-bearing.
